1. Select a new month in the calendar.
2. Confirm that the onmonthselect event is triggered.
3. Select a new year in the calendar.
4. Confirm that the onyearselect event is triggered.

Event Description

onmonthselect & onyearselect - Fired when the month or year is changed in the calendar.
